description: This file contains unit test fixtures and mock setup code for testing the ServerManagerModuleService component in a Rialto media server project. It defines mock expectations, helper functions, and test setup routines to verify the behavior of server configuration, state management, ping handling, and logging within the server module.

classes.name: ServerManagerModuleServiceTests
classes.description: Test fixture class for setting up mocks and helper methods to test ServerManagerModuleService functionalities.

methods.name: ServerManagerModuleServiceTests
methods.description: Constructor that initializes mock objects and creates the service under test.

methods.name: sessionServerManagerWillSetConfiguration
methods.description: Sets expectation that the session server manager will successfully set configuration with specified state.

methods.name: sessionServerManagerWillSetState
methods.description: Sets expectation that the session server manager will successfully set the server state.

methods.name: sessionServerManagerWillSetLogLevels
methods.description: Sets expectation that the session server manager will set log levels to debug.

methods.name: sessionServerManagerWillFailToSetConfiguration
methods.description: Sets expectation that the session server manager will fail to set configuration with specified state.

methods.name: sessionServerManagerWillFailToSetState
methods.description: Sets expectation that the session server manager will fail to set the server state.

methods.name: sessionServerManagerWillPing
methods.description: Sets expectation that the session server manager will successfully respond to a ping.

methods.name: sessionServerManagerWillFailToPing
methods.description: Sets expectation that the session server manager will fail to respond to a ping.

methods.name: sendSetConfiguration
methods.description: Constructs and sends a set configuration request with specified server state.

methods.name: sendSetState
methods.description: Constructs and sends a set state request with specified server state.

methods.name: sendSetLogLevels
methods.description: Constructs and sends a set log levels request.

methods.name: sendPing
methods.description: Sends a ping request with a predefined ID.

methods.name: sendPingWithInvalidController
methods.description: Sends a ping request using an invalid controller to test failure handling.

methods.name: sessionServerManagerWillHandleRequestSuccess
methods.description: Sets expectation that the request handler will invoke the success callback.

methods.name: sessionServerManagerWillHandleRequestFailure
methods.description: Sets expectation that the request handler will invoke the failure callback with a valid controller.

methods.name: sessionServerManagerWillHandleRequestFailureWithInvalidController
methods.description: Sets expectation that the request handler will invoke the failure callback with an invalid controller.
